architecture.boundary: OS-account-authorized stdio; finite declared tools; no public listener
One verified owner-delivered envelope; fixed read operations; 3attempts and128intents
Owned stores with immutable keys and resumable reconciliation; not distributed atomic commit or hostile same-UID isolation
Existing loopback public/read-only versus authenticated owner control

Zero arrivals are a valid idle condition
Recommendations do not authorize creating pods, paid resources or changing grants

completed jobs/second per worker for the actual workload
queue wait and end-to-end p95/p99 latency

modelSeparation.architecture: Existing runtime elements and owned state paths
modelSeparation.traceability: Explicit requirement-to-element-to-evidence relations; not a claim of universal isolation

requirements.acceptance: Invalid request -32600; invalid tool/arguments -32602; unknown method -32601; actual tool execution errors retain isError:true; MCP IDs are string/integer, excluding bool/null/fractional IDs; batch admission is1..64 requests, notifications receive no response.
requirements.obligation: Reject malformed request envelopes and declared tool arguments before actor execution

requirements.acceptance: Changed source or digest cannot replay the same key
requirements.obligation: Fence native command identity to the owner VFS object ID and exact UTF-8 content digest before effects

requirements.acceptance: Timeout/binding/transport/protocol failures have immutable attempt custody, never a completed health result
requirements.obligation: Preserve failed observation separately from completed command receipt

requirements.acceptance: Exact result readback after restart; attempt counter unchanged
requirements.obligation: Successful retained receipt survives manager process restart without re-execution

requirements.acceptance: Namespace and foundry attribution do not imply separate credential tenancy; public and owner interfaces remain distinct
requirements.obligation: Use existing owner identity and OS execution authority without granting new access

requirements.acceptance: No production capacity or scaling guarantee from arbitrary coefficients or aggregate node count
requirements.obligation: Qualify load and latency from measurements for each independently routed queue
